purpose: Multi-case benchmark for m7_jev_benchmark_v0_1.py, run against a real Kev/Jev-compatible /v1/systemone server across all three semantic conditions (STRICT/LABELED/GLOSSED). NOT the original 22-case Jev benchmark documented in documentation/P8_Jev_Kev_Local_Decision_Model_V0_1.md Sec. 2 -- that benchmark's raw cases were never committed to this repo (only its summary statistics were; verified absent by direct search before writing this corpus, not assumed). Built fresh here at the same scale (16 positive + 6 adversarial = 22) and with matching adversarial categories, so its own results are comparable in shape, never claimed to be a literal re-run of the original. Every subject/object name in 'cases' is disjoint from every name in WORKED_EXAMPLES (m7_jev_benchmark_v0_1.py) -- STRICT mode's opaque-symbol mapping is only meaningful if no test case's entities ever appeared in a worked example.
